landing.heroSubtext: QR Menu gives restaurants a complete digital storefront — contactless ordering, live table management, kitchen display, payments, loyalty, and analytics. All in one platform. All in under 5 minutes.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From QR code scanning to payment processing — every tool your restaurant needs, built right in. No plugins, no integrations, no extra cost.
landing.pricingBadge: Demo preview — pricing not yet live
landing.pricingSubtitle: Choose the plan that fits your restaurant. All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
landing.bottomCtaSubtitle: Join hundreds of restaurants already using QR Menu to serve faster, earn more, and delight customers.

qrOrdering.title: QR Contactless Ordering
qrOrdering.desc: Customers scan a QR code on the table, browse a rich digital menu, and order instantly — no app download required.

tableManagement.title: Real-time Table Management
tableManagement.desc: Track every table status live. See who ordered what, manage occupancy, and close sessions with one tap.

waiterPos.title: Waiter POS System
waiterPos.desc: Full-viewport mobile Point-of-Sale for waiters. Seat-level ordering, split bills, and tableside payment collection.

kitchenDisplay.title: Kitchen Display System
kitchenDisplay.desc: Live kanban board showing incoming orders, prep progress, and completed items. Kitchen stays in sync in real time.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-language Menus
multiLanguage.desc: Automatic DeepL translation into English, Bulgarian, and Romanian. Customers browse in their preferred language.

analytics.title: Smart Analytics
analytics.desc: Revenue trends, peak hour heatmaps, top-selling items, and customer behavior insights — all in your local timezone.

payments.title: Stripe Connect Payments
payments.desc: Accept card payments directly at the table. Customers tip, pay, and leave — all without flagging down a waiter.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Program
loyalty.desc: VIP tiers with configurable multipliers, happy hour bonuses, and FIFO point ledger. Customers earn and redeem seamlessly.

branding.title: Branding Studio
branding.desc: Custom accent colors, Google Fonts picker, logo upload, and WCAG contrast validator. Your menu, your brand.

staffAccess.title: Staff Access Control
staffAccess.desc: Assign Owner, Manager, Waiter, or Kitchen roles. PIN-based login for shared devices. Fine-grained permission matrix.

feedback.title: Customer Feedback
feedback.desc: Collect reviews after each visit, filter by rating, and redirect happy customers to your Google review page.

menuImport.title: Menu Import & Export
menuImport.desc: Bulk-import menu items from structured files. Export for backup, cross-location cloning, or offline editing.

tiers.starterDesc: Perfect for a single restaurant getting started with digital menus.
tiers.proDesc: For growing restaurants that want analytics, payments, and branding.
tiers.enterpriseDesc: For restaurant groups needing unlimited scale and custom integrations.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Prices shown exclude VAT. Your local VAT rate applies at checkout via Stripe.
faq.a2: Yes. Cancel via the Billing portal at any time. You keep access until the end of the current billing period.
faq.a3: You move to the new plan's features immediately. Stripe applies a prorated credit for unused time toward your next invoice.
faq.a4: The FREE plan is permanent with no time limit — it is your trial. Upgrade whenever you are ready.
faq.a5: Stripe charges 1.4% + €0.25 per EU card transaction. There is no additional platform fee from us.
faq.q6: Can I switch between monthly and yearly billing?
faq.a6: Yes, via the Billing portal. The change takes effect at your next billing date.
